scope: Read-only installed worker entry-handler inspection; no vendor startup or personal criteria executed

core_dispatch.finding: The same JournalBase instance is passed to each worker in iteration order. Typed mutations can be visible to later consumers; Json remains the original independently retained journal string.

workers.name: BioInsights
workers.finding: Enqueues the same JournalBase object, casts it to Scan, and reads typed fields. The located Scan Json getter call supplies verbose logging.

workers.name: Evaluator
workers.finding: Casts the incoming object to Scan and consumes typed getters. The located raw JSON deserialization in the entry handler parses extra CarrierJump flags.

workers.name: Hecate
workers.finding: The asynchronous entry state retains the original typed object for routing and system metadata, while journal archival appends its original Json string into journalText. Stellar calculations reached through archive reparse must retain those raw bytes.

workers.name: Botanist
workers.finding: The entry handler switches over typed JournalBase subclasses, including SAASignalsFound and ScanOrganic.

workers.name: Communicator
workers.finding: The entry handler reads typed LoadGame, SendText and ReceiveText properties; it does not consume Scan.

limits: Static entry-handler evidence establishes typed versus raw boundaries. It does not establish exact cross-worker scheduling for asynchronously queued events.
